what: Over a slider, a circular arrow (60px) replaces the mouse cursor and sticks right to the cursor position (offset 30 left and 12 up), turning on and off with .3s ease. On the left half of the panel it points left, on the right half it points right. Clicking advances in the pointed direction (presses the prev or next button, or fires fx:prev or fx:next). The ‹next› type always points right and advances to the next. It is turned off below 1001px and on touch devices.

options.mode: halves (default — direction follows the half) or next (always next)
options.min: Minimum window width to turn on (px), default 1001
options.x · y: Distance to move aside from the cursor spot to the arrow’s top left (px), default 30 · 12
options.[data-fx-part=area]: (If present) inner panel where the cursor turns on — if absent, the whole element
options.[data-fx-part=prev] · [data-fx-part=next: (optional) prev/next buttons to press instead on tap. The cursor does not advance when over a button
options.[data-fx-part=cursor]: (if present) arrow graphic — if absent, a circular arrow SVG is created
options.--fx-fade: On/off fade length (css), default .3s — Brand E 0s (appears and disappears instantly)
options.hide: (If present) css that hides the cursor inside it and does not pass presses through (card links, More button) — source site .jc, .sm-btn
options.look: If turn, when the direction changes the image rotates 180° over --fx-turn (default .2s) instead of flipping like a mirror
options.--fx-from · --fx-ease: Size before turning on and on-Curve (css), default 1 · ease — brand .5 · cubic-bezier(.19,1,.22,1) (appears growing from small)

note: Place the cursor inside the panel with position: fixed — if the panel or an ancestor has a transform, it becomes that box’s reference and the position goes off. A slider library (Swiper etc.) only needs to receive fx:prev and fx:next and call slidePrev and slideNext
